purpose: Verify explicit node routing, recipient token accounting and conservative replay across two fixed local model families. Not an algorithm candidate or positive scientific evidence.

What color is Mira's card?

pass_conditions: Every affected-closure replay equals a fresh execution in prompts, seeds, generated text and normalized messages

format_policy: Report malformed fractions by model; no format or synthetic accuracy threshold is used to claim benchmark readiness. Any poor format behavior requires a separate documented engineering decision before formal experiments.
excluded_claims: No reproduction of the frozen R1 scientific experiment
failure_policy: Preserve all calls and costs. Repair implementation under a new qualification version if required; never retry a failed call silently. Candidate and project decisions are unaffected.
